title: Optimizing MILC-Dslash Performance on NVIDIA A100 GPU: Parallel Strategies using SYCL
problem: The MILC-Dslash kernel simulation has suboptimal GPU utilization on NVIDIA A100, with performance varying significantly based on parallel strategy choices. The challenge is determining which work-item indexing, work-group configuration, and memory access patterns maximize performance.
motivation: Optimizing lattice gauge theory simulations is critical for advancing high-performance physics computations at scale.
method: The authors employ a systematic progression of parallelism granularity in the MILC-Dslash kernel using SYCL. They explore different work-item index orders, work-group sizes, and memory access patterns while investigating atomic memory operations, shared variables, divergent instructions, and synchronization barriers. Variants use SYCL complex library (SyclCPLX) and the SYCLomatic tool to guide optimization decisions.
key_novelty: Systematic characterization of how SYCL parallel strategy choices (work-item indexing, work-group configuration, local memory usage) impact MILC-Dslash performance, revealing that GPU resource utilization should be prioritized even at the expense of concurrency.
contributions: Systematic exploration and benchmarking of multiple SYCL parallel strategies for MILC-Dslash including work-item indexing, work-group sizing, and memory access patterns
Achieved 2x speedup over simplest strategy and 10% improvement over QUDA baseline through enhanced parallelism and work-group local memory optimization
Practical guidance for GPU optimization including work-item indexing methods favoring localized memory access, resource utilization prioritization, and active work-item sequencing
Investigation of atomic operations, divergent instructions, and synchronization barriers in SYCL implementations

metrics.speedup: 2x over simplest strategy; 10% over QUDA baseline

limitations: The study focuses on NVIDIA A100 GPUs specifically; generalizability to other GPU architectures or applications beyond MILC-Dslash is not discussed.
primary_theme: SYCL-based GPU kernel optimization for HPC
